bio: This exciting and unique animal experience at Charnwood Forest Alpacas is perfect for a pair of animal lovers, who enjoy getting close to nature! You and your companion can enjoy getting up close and interacting with some friendly alpacas, as you lead your very own alpaca partner on a 30 minute stroll around the 110 acre farm, under the guidance of an expert handler who will show you everything you need to know to make the most out of your fun experience! This cheeky bunch of animals all have their own great personalities and you will be sure to have a favourite of the bunch! After all that fresh air and exercise, you will be ready for your delicious sparkling afternoon tea at the Chilli Bean Café! Both of you will enjoy a glass of bubbly, as you tuck into tasty sandwiches, crispy sweet potato fries with amazing ‘banana ketchup’, warm scones and a selection of delicate cakes!
